sweetArrival.title: Sweet Arrival
sweetArrival.text: The map still makes no sense, but the {flavor} is perfect. You got here on your own.
sweetArrival.hint: Get directions, then go it alone.

newFriend.title: New Friend
newFriend.text: Two cones, one bench, and a stranger who isn't a stranger anymore. He even knows a shortcut home.
newFriend.hint: Be good company on the train.

wrongStop.title: Wrong Stop
wrongStop.text: The doors close behind you. The sign says WILLOW PARK. The ice cream shop is very, very far away.
wrongStop.hint: What happens if the conversation goes badly?

secretGarden.title: Secret Garden
secretGarden.text: Behind a door with no sign, the city goes quiet. Whoever wrote your name on that envelope wanted you to find this.

start.line: This line's always late. Where are you headed with that giant map?

choices.text: "The famous ice cream place! Do you know it?"
choices.recap: Asked about the ice cream shop

icecream.line: Oh, the famous one? You're three stops away. Get off at Elm Street.

choices.recap: Asked him to show the way
choices.reaction: Sure. I'm getting off there anyway, and I never say no to ice cream.
Good luck. Elm Street, don't forget.
He shrugs and goes back to his book. You look up three stops too late.

book.line: It's about a guy who gets lost in a city. Kind of like you, actually.

choices.reaction: I knew it. Come on, I'll walk you there. It's on my way.

choices.text: "Do you know how to get to the ice cream place?"
choices.reaction: Elm Street, three stops. You can't miss it.
Wow. Okay. He moves to another seat, and you miss the announcement for your stop.

suspicious.line: Relax. I was just trying to help.

choices.text: "Sorry. I'm lost and a little stressed."
choices.reaction: No worries. Elm Street, three stops. Breathe.

choices.recap: Told him to mind his business
choices.reaction: He calls the conductor over. At the next stop, you're asked to step off the train.
The silence gets awkward. You stare at the floor so hard you miss your stop.
